name: chilkat/chilkat2
description: Chilkat2 PHP: installs the chilkat2 extension (namespace Chilkat2\: Http, Crypt2, Email, MailMan, Imap, Ftp2, SFtp, Ssh, Rest, Zip, JsonObject, Xml, Pdf, Cert, Jwt, ...) matching your PHP with vendor/bin/chilkat2-install, and provides its IDE / static-analysis stub.

suggest.ext-chilkat2: The extension that defines the Chilkat2\ classes; installed by vendor/bin/chilkat2-install (see README).
suggest.ext-curl: Lets chilkat2-install download the extension with the curl extension instead of stream wrappers.
suggest.ext-zlib: Lets chilkat2-install extract the .tar.gz packages without a tar command.
